s.n: Frat party pork and fennel sausage rolls
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated apple, 1 grated onion, 2 tsp crushed fennel seeds, 30g breadcrumbs and pepper. Cut 2 sheets puff pastry in half. Lay a log of filling along each strip, roll up and seal underneath. Brush with 1 beaten egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and cut each into 4. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden. Serve with 200g tomato relish stirred with 1/2 tsp smoked paprika.

s.n: Date night baked brie with honey walnuts
s.note: Mac and Kelly at home with baby Stella
s.how: Unwrap a 200g brie wheel, score the top in a criss-cross and sit it in a small ovenproof dish. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes until soft and molten. Meanwhile toast 50g walnuts in a dry pan for 4 minutes and warm them with 2 tbsp honey and a few thyme leaves. Spoon over the hot brie. Slice 1 baguette thinly, brush with oil and bake 8 minutes. Serve with the toasts and 300g grapes.

m.note: Mac and Kelly trying to make friends next door
m.how: Blitz 1 bunch parsley, 2 garlic cloves, 1 tsp dried oregano, 1/2 tsp chilli flakes, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil. Grill 4 corn cobs for 10 minutes, turning. Grill 8 pork sausages for 12 minutes. Season 800g rump steak and grill over high heat for 4 minutes a side, then rest 5 minutes and slice. Toss shredded cabbage and 1 julienned apple with 3 tbsp mayonnaise and lemon. Spoon chimichurri over the steak.

w.how: Beat 200g soft butter with 250g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 3 eggs and 2 tsp vanilla, then fold in 300g self-raising flour and 200ml milk. Fold through 60g rainbow sprinkles. Spread into a lined 23 x 33cm tin and bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Cool. Beat 250g cream cheese with 80g butter and 300g icing sugar until fluffy, spread over the cake and finish with more sprinkles.

d.how: In a big jug or punch bowl, mix 1L pineapple juice, the pulp of 4 passionfruit, the juice of 2 limes and 200ml white rum. Chill for 30 minutes. Just before serving, add 1L cold lemonade, 2 sliced oranges and plenty of ice. Stir gently and scatter with mint. Make a second jug without rum for anyone not drinking.
